messages:
Ava (Design): putting this thread up — quick feedback request on the new chart card compact mode and how we handle legends/outliers. attaching prototype link: https://figma.com/proto/xxx
Jun (Product): thanks! TL;DR what are the open questions?
Ava (Design): 1) legend density: do we auto-collapse to a single row + +X overflow or show a vertical list? 2) axis units: should we abbreviate to 'k'/'M' or show full with tooltip? 3) outliers: clamp to axis vs inset/outlier marker? 4) smoothing toggle placement (global vs per-series)
Maya (Eng): from infra side, vertical list is heavier for many series (DOM) but doable. collapse + overflow is easiest perf-wise.
Olga (Data): telemetry shows users often compare 3-4 lines at once — overflow hides some context. maybe collapse only when >6 series?
Sam (Accessibility): keyboard nav for collapsed legend needs to expose hidden items via a listbox pattern. also contrast on the collapsed chip is low on dark bg.
Ava (Design): proposal: default to horizontal single-line legend, overflow +X opens a popover with searchable list. per-series controls (toggle/label) stay in popover. keeps top chrome compact.
Jun (Product): sounds good. copy tweak: instead of '+3', use '+3 more' for clarity (microcopy A/B).
Ava (Design): noted. also thinking about unit label — show abbreviated tick labels (1k) but on hover show full value in tooltip and include an aria-label on the axis like 'Requests per second, values in thousands'.
Sam (Accessibility): yes to aria-label. make sure 'k' and 'M' are not announced as letters — screenreader should speak 'thousand' and 'million'. we can add aria-hidden on visual and have an offscreen full text.
Maya (Eng): implementation note — will add a formatter fn and an ariaLabel getter. pseudo: ```js
function axisLabel(value){ return {visual: formatShort(value), sr: formatLong(value)} }
```
Olga (Data): outlier suggestion: show inset mini-chart for the zoomed region when detection finds a single spike > 5x median. good for preserving axis scale while surfacing spike.
Ava (Design): I like inset for spikes but worried about cognitive load. alternative: render a small marker with hover-to-zoom.
Jun (Product): can we A/B test inset vs marker? track click-to-expand, comprehension task in product analytics.
Ava (Design): yes. I'll add both variations to the prototype. quick accessibility nit: legend items should be 44px tappable min on mobile.
Sam (Accessibility): +1. also focus ring visible on high-contrast theme.
Maya (Eng): dev question — is smoothing toggled per-card or per-series? per-series increases controls complexity but is more flexible.
Ava (Design): MVP: per-card toggle (global smoothing) with a per-series override in the popover for power users.
Olga (Data): add a note to evals that smoothing can hide regressions — we should expose raw toggle in debug view for eval runs.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued for charting-service v2.3.0 — expected rollout 2026-04-02 18:00 UTC.
Jun (Product): timeline: can we get prototype -> dev in two sprints, then A/B import?
Maya (Eng): yes, will slot into sprint after next. I'll chase perf numbers for legend overflow.
Ava (Design): thanks team — I'll update figma and post short diff when done. :thumbsup:
